cells.gaps: No regulation under organic law 2004-63 and no dated sanction, decision or count under it has been found. A health ministry official told the Assembly in February 2026 that the INPDP has ceased its activities since 2024 (TUN-025), so the authority is provided and not acting.
cells.note: Organic law 2004-63 is in force, so stage 3; stage 4 needs a dated applied or reported fact within three years and none is held. The bill before the Assembly (TUN-024, February 2026) is the under revision flag and its committee hearing the advancing flag; the INPDP's standstill would cap any higher stage.
